answer: Each identity must hold one matched pair: a berth at the wharf and a mooring at one inlet, entered in the pair table, with a 70-credit bond locked on the pair. Each epoch a zephyr table lists the berth-inlet pairs, and a pair absent from it burns its bond. A berth costs 50 and a mooring 40, so one fake pays 160 and 1000 fakes pay 160,000, no bulk discount: one pair, one identity. A rented-pair ring fails: auditors replay the table, and a reused pair or a wrongly matched berth burns both bonds. An honest identity pays 50 plus 40 once and keeps its bond after a clean epoch.
